site_name: Site Known As Phase 4, Land Bounded By Seven Sisters Road, Rear Of St. Olave’s Church, Woodberry Down And
description: Advertisement Consent Application to install vinyl wrapped advertisements onto 367sqm of hoarding for Phase 4 of the Woodberry Down Regeneration Scheme.
decision_conditions: <p>1<span style="white-space:pre">	</span>Standard Advertisement Cond 1</p><p>No advertisement is to be displayed without the permission of the owner of the site or any other person with an interest in the site entitled to grant permission.&nbsp;</p><p>Reason: To comply with the Town and Country Planning (Control of Advertisements) (England) Regulations 2007</p><div><br></div>

<p>2 <span style="white-space:pre">	</span>Standard Advertisement Cond 2</p><p>No advertisement shall be sited or displayed so as to -&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp;</p><p>(a) endanger persons using any highway, railway, waterway, dock, harbour or aerodrome (civil or military);&nbsp;</p><p>(b) obscure, or hinder the ready interpretation of, any traffic sign, railway&nbsp; signal or aid to navigation by water or air;&nbsp;</p><p>(c)or hinder the operation of any device used for the purpose of security or surveillance or for measuring the speed of any vehicle.&nbsp;</p><p>Reason: To comply with the Town and Country Planning (Control of Advertisements) (England) Regulations 2007</p>

<p>3 <span style="white-space:pre">	</span>Standard Advertisement Cond 3</p><p>Any advertisement displayed, and any site used for the display of advertisements, shall be maintained in a condition that does not impair the visual amenity of the site.&nbsp;</p><p>Reason: To comply with the Town and Country Planning (Control of Advertisements) (England) Regulations 2007</p>

<p>4 Standard Advertisement Cond 4</p><p>Any structure or hoarding erected or used for the display of advertisements shall be maintained in a condition that does not endanger the public.&nbsp;</p><p>Reason: To comply with the Town and Country Planning (Control of Advertisements) (England) Regulations 2007</p>

<p>5 <span style="white-space:pre">	</span>Standard Advertisement Cond 5</p><p>Where an advertisement is required under these Regulations to be removed, the site shall be left in a condition that does not endanger the public or impair visual amenity.&nbsp;&nbsp;</p><p>Reason: To comply with the Town and Country Planning (Control of Advertisements) (England) Regulations 2007</p>

<p>6 Approved Plans</p><p>The hereby permitted shall be carried out in complete accordance with the approved plans:&nbsp;&nbsp;</p><p>WD0001 – SITE PLAN (December 2025)</p><p>WD0002 – OVERALL HOARDING PLAN (December 2025)</p><p>Woodberry Down The Grove Hoarding Planning Document (December 2025)</p><p><br></p><p><br></p><p>Reason: For the avoidance of doubt, and in the interests of proper planning.&nbsp;</p><div><br></div>

<p>7<span style="white-space:pre">	</span>Time Limit for Removal.&nbsp;</p><p>The advertisements hereby approved shall be removed after 5 years of the date of this notice.&nbsp;</p><p>Reason: To ensure that the character of the area is protected once the development is completed.&nbsp; &nbsp;</p>
